title: Senior Client Success Manager
description:
Senior Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Client Success Manager with 7+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.

Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 7+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Fluency in Python, SQL

title: Analytics Engineer - Sênior
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
  • Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Apoia e pareia com analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;

Diferencial

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.

title: Network Engineer- 12x36
description:
We are looking for a Network Engineer in Londrina!

Must have:

  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • Cisco Firepower (configuration, troubleshooting, policy management)
  • Palo Alto firewalls (security policies, VPNs, threat prevention)
  • Cisco routers and switches (routing, switching, VLAN, VxLAN, high availability)
  • Solid understanding of:
  • DNS management and IP addressing
  • Wi-Fi troubleshooting and optimization
  • Ability to:
  • Perform hardware support, including RMA processes
  • Use network monitoring tools for proactive issue resolution
  • Mastery of DNS concepts and practices, including:reservation and management of public and private IP addresses
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Good to know:

  • CCNA/CCNP or equivalent networking certifications
  • Cloud networking (AWS, Azure, OCI)

Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role

  • Firewall & Security Management
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco Firepower and Palo Alto firewalls, ensuring compliance with security policies.
  • Implement VPNs, intrusion prevention, and threat mitigation strategies.
  • Routing & Switching
  • Deploy and manage Cisco routers and switches, including VLAN configuration, routing protocols, and network optimization.
  • Ensure high availability and performance of core network infrastructure.
  • Network Services
  • Administer DNS and DHCP services for reliable name resolution and IP management.
  • Maintain accurate IP addressing schemes and documentation.
  • Wireless Networking
  • Provide support for Wi-Fi infrastructure, including troubleshooting connectivity issues and optimizing coverage.
  • Hardware Support
  • Manage RMA processes for defective hardware and coordinate with vendors for timely replacements.
  • Ensure proper installation and maintenance of network hardware.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting
  • Utilize network monitoring tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Documentation & Compliance
  • Maintain detailed network diagrams, configurations, and operational documentation.
  • Adhere to industry best practices and organizational security standards.

title: Regional Sales Manager, Brazil
description:
Accelerate Your Career in Cybersecurity

Join Pentera and take your career to the next level in cybersecurity. As a leader in Automated Security Validation, we help businesses around the world safely emulate real-world attacks to uncover their vulnerabilities—just like the world’s best red teams. At Pentera, you’ll be at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, working on advanced tools that challenge organizations' defenses and push the limits of security testing.

With over 350 team members and 1,000+ customers in more than 50 countries, Pentera is a growing company supported by top investors like Insight Partners, K1, and The Blackstone Group.

If you're looking to grow your skills, make a difference, and be part of an innovative team, Pentera is the place for you.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated, self-driven, and experienced Regional Sales Manager specializing in enterprise sales, based in Brazil. The ideal candidate is passionate about helping organizations defend against the world’s most advanced attackers and thrives in a high-velocity sales environment.

You’ll work closely with SDRs, ISRs, and channel partners to drive regional growth. You should bring a strong network of executive-level contacts, be adaptable to change, and have a proven ability to deliver results. We’re looking for someone who is customer-focused, driven, and ready to attack the market with energy and precision.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Identify, develop, and execute an enterprise account strategy to close new business opportunities and expand revenue across the assigned region.
  • Scope, negotiate, and close agreements to meet or exceed booking and revenue quota targets.
  • Access and build relationships with key decision-makers in enterprise accounts.
  • Lead demos and complex pilots as a hands-on, customer-facing professional.
  • Collaborate with end customers and channel partners to generate and close enterprise sales opportunities.
  • Act as a strategic influencer with resellers and distributors to drive pipeline and deal flow.
  • Take full ownership of sales forecasting, pipeline management, and reporting to regional leadership.

Requirements

  • Direct quota carrier with 3+ years of experience in enterprise cybersecurity sales, with a track record of exceeding targets.
  • Strong results orientation with expertise in forecasting, pipeline management, and discipline around sales metrics.
  • Consultative sales skills with the ability to present Pentera’s technology and align it to both business and technical outcomes.
  • Proven relationship in the region with decision makers like CIO, CTO, CFO, CISO
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships with senior executives.
  • Experience working in and managing a CRM-based pipeline and forecast.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree, or equivalent education and experience.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Self-starter with strong individual accountability and team collaboration mindset.
  • Competitive, driven, and motivated by success in complex enterprise sales.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% as needed across the Brazil region.
  • Creative and adaptable in navigating enterprise sales challenges.
  • A growth mindset and openness to feedback and learning.
  • Experience in launching or scaling a new enterprise-level solution is a plus.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to building a diverse and talented workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, sex, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by applicable law. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join us!

title: Coordenador(a) Manutenção Logística
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Planejar, coordenar e controlar as atividades de manutenção da frota e dos ativos logísticos, assegurando alta disponibilidade operacional, segurança, confiabilidade e otimização de custos, em alinhamento com as metas da gerência, produção e nível de serviço da Arauco.

Principais Atividades:

  • Assegurar a execução do plano de manutenção das frotas sob sua responsabilidade, monitorando os pontos críticos do fluxo e antecipando riscos, com intervenções rápidas para evitar rupturas e impactos na produção.
  • Liderar e auditar o desempenho das equipes próprias e terceiras parceiras, monitorando disponibilidade de frota, produtividade, segurança e custo.
  • Gerir os custos da área, realizando a previsão orçamentária anual e o acompanhamento mensal do realizado, por meio de aprovações de gastos, análises críticas e ações de otimização para garantir aderência ao orçamento.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores de gestão (KPIs) das empresas prestadoras de serviço, garantindo a aderência contratual e a sustentabilidade econômico-financeira dos contratos sob sua gestão.
  • Conduzir a melhoria contínua, mapeando oportunidades, priorizando iniciativas e assegurando a implementação de ações que elevem segurança, produtividade, qualidade e eficiência de custos.
  • Participar da construção do planejamento semanal, mensal e anual de manutenção, assim como construir em conjunto com as áreas clientes como será o plano operacional dos períodos.
  • Gerenciar a manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva da frota logística (caminhões, carretas, implementos, equipamentos de apoio, gruas, tractors, etc).
  • Estruturar modelo de governança para acompanhamento dos resultados e planos de ação dos desvios.

title: Network Technician
description:
Job Description: Network Technician

Locations : Guarulhos, Brazil

Contract: Long Term

About Teceze

Teceze is a global IT services and consulting company providing reliable end-user computing, infrastructure support, and managed IT services to enterprise clients. We deliver high-quality on-site and remote support, ensuring seamless IT operations for our customers.

Job Overview

Teceze is hiring a Network Technician – Level 1 to support one of our enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will provide first-level network and infrastructure support, assist with installations, troubleshooting, and monitoring, and ensure stable network operations at the client site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 support for network-related issues including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and basic routing/switching problems
  • Assist in installation, configuration, and maintenance of network devices such as switches, routers, access points, and firewalls
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to Level 2/3 teams
  • Monitor network performance and report incidents, outages, and security concerns
  • Support cable management, patching, and rack-and-stack activities in data centers and IDF/MDF rooms
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and incident logs
  • Assist with user connectivity issues including VPN, wireless access, and port activation
  • Follow client and Teceze IT standards, policies, and change management procedures
  • Coordinate with onsite and remote teams to ensure timely resolution of issues

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 0–2 years of experience in network or IT infrastructure support
  • Basic knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and subnetting
  • Familiarity with networking hardware (Cisco, HP, Aruba, or similar)
  • Understanding of wired and wireless network concepts
  • Ability to troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Willingness to work onsite and provide shift or on-call support if required

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNA or equivalent networking certification (or in progress)
  • Experience in enterprise or client-facing environments
  • Basic knowledge of network security concepts

departamento;

• Pacote Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel avançado e Outlook)

• Experiência em comércio exterior (importação/exportação) e seus processos;

title: DevOps Engineer - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Cloud Infrastructure & Orchestration

  • Architect and manage container platforms (AWS ECS or EKS) ensuring scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance critical for financial transactions.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation to standardize environments and ensure reproducibility across development, staging, and production.
  • Manage AWS Networking components (VPCs, Subnets, Transit Gateways, Route 53, Load Balancers) with a focus on network segregation and security best practices.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to support agile software delivery while enforcing strict quality gates and security checks.
  • Automate operational tasks using Python or Bash to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Drive the "Shift-Left" approach, integrating testing and security scanning early in the development lifecycle.

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Configure and maintain comprehensive observability solutions (APM, dashboards, distributed tracing, and centralized logging) to ensure real-time visibility into system health.
  • Proactively monitor application performance and infrastructure metrics to prevent incidents and optimize resource utilization.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets to maintain the reliability required for a 24/7 financial operation.

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure secure container lifecycles, managing ECR (Image Registry) with strict vulnerability scanning and patching routines for third-party and internal images.
  • Implement security controls and access management (IAM) aligned with financial regulatory standards (e.g., BACEN, LGPD) and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Security team to implement immutable infrastructure and ensure audit trails for all infrastructure changes.

Requirements

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English (technical reading and writing are essential).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Solid knowledge of Python and proficiency in Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Deep proficiency in Docker, container orchestration (ECS or EKS), and Helm.
  • Experience with AWS networking architecture and security groups.
  • Practical experience with APM tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) and logging stacks (ELK, Splunk, CloudWatch).

Differentiators (Nice to have)

  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional or Solutions Architect Professional.
  • CKA/CKAD (Kubernetes) Certification.
  • Prior experience in the Financial Sector (FinTechs, Banks, Payments), specifically dealing with regulatory requirements and critical mission environments.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD).

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Java Senior (Spring Boot e PostgreSQL)
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

O DESAFIO:

● Desenvolver aplicações e serviços backend em Java (usando Spring Boot) focados no processamento e integração de dados, incluindo a construção de APIs RESTful ou microserviços que permitam o consumo e fornecimento de dados via base dimensional.

● Implementar pipelines de dados e fluxos de processamento em Java, integrando com sistemas de mensageria (ex: Apache Kafka) e outros mecanismos de streaming quando necessário, para capturar dados transacionais em tempo real e persistí-los de forma segura.

● Projetar e otimizar esquemas de banco de dados PostgreSQL para armazenar dados = provenientes de sistemas legados ou da camada de ingestão, garantindo normalização adequada ou modelagem relacional conforme necessário, além de criar índices e otimizar consultas para alto desempenho.

● Colaborar com o time de arquitetura e outros engenheiros de dados para assegurar que as soluções desenvolvidas em Java/PostgreSQL estejam alinhadas com a arquitetura dimensional e não gerem redundâncias ou inconsistências com as demais fontes de dados.

● Implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e monitoramento nos serviços desenvolvidos, assegurando que falhas sejam rapidamente identificadas (logs, métricas, telemetria) e colaborando com a equipe de SRE para implantar monitoramento e alertas adequados.

● Participar da integração de dados entre o PostgreSQL e outras camadas da plataforma (por exemplo, exportando dados para Data Lake ou fornecendo dados atualizados para aplicações de relatório), escrevendo scripts ou procedimentos armazenados quando necessário.

● Dar suporte e manutenção evolutiva aos componentes desenvolvidos, tanto durante a fase de construção quanto na sustentação posterior, incluindo documentação clara do código e das integrações realizadas.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Experiência em construção de APIs REST e microserviços, com práticas de versionamento, segurança (autenticação/autorização) e documentação (OpenAPI/Swagger).

● Familiaridade com sistemas de mensageria e event streaming (Kafka ou similares) e integração de aplicações Java com esses sistemas (producers/consumers, processamento de eventos).

● Conhecimento de ferramentas de build e entrega contínua para Java (Maven/Gradle, Jenkins/GitLab CI) e experiência básica em containerização (Docker) para deploy dos serviços.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro.

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil

SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .

Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.

Visit our website: siila.com.br

About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

Follow us: @siila.br

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr

Executar e supervisionar planos de lubrificação preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos rotativos e estáticos; Definir, avaliar e aplicar os tipos adequados de lubrificantes (graxas, óleos, fluidos especiais), assegurando conformidade com especificações técnicas e recomendações de fabricantes; Monitorar o consumo e desempenho dos lubrificantes, realizando análises de tendência e propondo melhorias de confiabilidade; Realizar coleta de óleo para análise laboratorial (físico-química e ferrográfica), interpretando resultados e recomendando ações corretivas; Implementar e manter rotas de lubrificação em sistemas digitais (CMMS/ERP), garantindo rastreabilidade das atividades; Diagnosticar falhas relacionadas a sistemas de lubrificação e propor soluções para eliminação de recorrências; Orientar e treinar equipes de manutenção quanto às melhores práticas de lubrificação e inspeção de equipamentos; Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas de manutenção, fornecendo suporte técnico sobre processos de lubrificação; Atuar junto às áreas de engenharia de manutenção e confiabilidade no desenvolvimento de novos procedimentos e otimização de intervalos de lubrificação; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade na manipulação, armazenamento e descarte de lubrificantes.

Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Requisitos & Competências:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

title: Representantes de Negócio
description:
Grow Up by MetLife | Representantes de Negócio

Sobre a iniciativa

Sua empresa poderá fazer parte de uma iniciativa estratégica da MetLife voltada ao desenvolvimento de Representantes de Negócio, com foco em expansão comercial e construção de operações sustentáveis.

O Grow Up by MetLife foi concebido para empresas com expertise empresarial que atuam com protagonismo estratégico, alinhando a operação própria ao modelo de negócios da companhia.

A oportunidade

O Grow Up by MetLife é um programa de aceleração executiva, estruturado para transferir know-how para futuros parceiros comerciais na modalidade de Representantes MetLife.

  • Etapa 1 – Base de Negócios (6 meses): imersão prática no negócio, desenvolvimento comercial, conhecimento técnico de produtos e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Etapa 2 – Consolidação (18 meses): ampliação de atuação, construção de carteira, visão de gestão e apoio à expansão comercial.
  • Etapa 3 – Escalada: consolidação como líder de negócio, com autonomia, estrutura própria e capacidade de multiplicar resultados.

A jornada contempla etapas progressivas de desenvolvimento em gestão comercial, governança e expansão territorial, com foco em resultados de longo prazo. Em decorrência da progressão, o parceiro terá o know-how relacionado ao desenvolvimento de mercado e consolidação de resultados, culminando na condução de uma operação própria, com autonomia estratégica.

Principais objetos do modelo de parceria

- Conduzir a estratégia de expansão comercial do seu negócio em parceria com a MetLife na região de atuação da sua empresa, a partir de análises de mercado e planejamento estratégico.

- Estruturar, assessorar e dar suporte a Parceiros Comerciais, assegurando produtividade e qualidade.

- Gerir e expandir a carteira de negócios de sua empresa com foco em crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e recorrência.

- Atuar de forma consultiva junto a clientes e parceiros estratégicos, fortalecendo relacionamentos.

- Assegurar excelência técnica e conformidade com as diretrizes legais e administrativas.

Requisitos para atuação no programa

- Atuação empresarial consolidada em atividades comerciais, preferencialmente consultivas, complexas e de alta responsabilidade.

- Experiência da empresa em projetos de expansão ou desenvolvimento de operações comerciais.

- Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e domínio técnico para tomada de decisões no nível empresarial.

- Presença e penetração de mercado, com influência e capacidade de negociação em diferentes níveis.

- Perfil empresarial empreendedor, com compromisso com resultados e construção sustentável no longo prazo.

Diferenciais

- Histórico consistente da empresa na formação, desenvolvimento e gestão de times comerciais.

- Atuação prévia da empresa como representante ou responsável por unidades de negócio.

- Capacidade da empresa de estruturar processos comerciais e indicadores de performance.

Por que o Grow Up by MetLife

O Grow Up by MetLife é destinado a empresas que buscam solidez, independência estratégica e geração de valor, contando com o respaldo institucional de uma multinacional e a liberdade de empreender.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Infraestrutura Especialista (SRE)
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

O DESAFIO:

● Planejar, implantar e manter a infraestrutura necessária para o pipeline de dados, incluindo servidores, containers ou clusters (por exemplo, configuração de clusters Spark/Databricks, instâncias de banco de dados PostgreSQL, clusters MongoDB e brokers Kafka), seja em ambiente de nuvem ou on-premises, garantindo configurações adequadas de alta disponibilidade e redundância.

● Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automação de deploy das aplicações e componentes de dados (serviços Java, notebooks Databricks, configurações de bancos), promovendo entregas constantes e confiáveis sem interrupção do serviço.

● Implementar soluções de monitoramento, logging e alerta para todos os componentes da plataforma (uso de ferramentas como Prometheus/Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes), garantindo observabilidade completa do sistema (métricas de performance, falhas, latências, utilização de recursos) e resposta rápida a incidentes.

● Trabalhar junto aos engenheiros de dados e desenvolvedores para melhorar a confiabilidade das aplicações, revisando configurações, identificando pontos únicos de falha e implementando soluções de resiliência (como balanceamento de carga, retries automáticos, fallback).

● Gerenciar a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, aplicando atualizações de sistema, patches de segurança, configurações de firewall e acessos apropriados, em alinhamento com políticas corporativas e requisitos (por exemplo, LGPD).

● Otimizar a performance e custo da infraestrutura, monitorando uso de recursos e escalando ambientes conforme necessidade (vertical ou horizontalmente), bem como implementando rotinas de housekeeping (expurgo de logs, archiving de dados) para manter o ambiente saudável.

● Liderar a resposta a incidentes críticos relacionados à infraestrutura ou disponibilidade dos sistemas de dados, investigando raiz de problemas (post- mortem) e implementando ações preventivas para evitar recorrências.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Domínio de sistemas operacionais Linux e competências em automação de infraestrutura (shell scripting, Python) e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares).

● Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) para gerir serviços containerizados e escalar aplicações.

● Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) ou com ambientes virtualizados on-premises, compreendendo rede, armazenamento e computação, e habilidade para configurar serviços como bancos de dados gerenciados, balanceadores de carga, etc.

● Prática em configurar e manter ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, etc.) e interpretar métricas para troubleshooting.

● Familiaridade com conceitos de SRE, incluindo definição de SLOs/SLAs, error budget, e experiência em protocolos de resposta a incidentes.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Business Analyst - Workday
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Workday Business Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Business Processes (BPs) and functional integration knowledge . This is a strategic, functional role — not a technical development position — acting as a bridge between HR business teams, IT development, and QA.

The successful candidate will play a central role in translating business needs into clear process and integration requirements, ensuring alignment between Workday Business Processes and downstream integrations, and coordinating testing cycles to deliver high-quality solutions in a global Workday environment.

Serve as a functional expert in Workday Business Processes , understanding end-to-end process flows.

Write and maintain Business and System Requirements for new integrations and process enhancements.

Act as liaison between business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams .

Translate business requirements into functional specifications aligned with Workday configuration and integration frameworks.

Review current business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend best practices.

Coordinate and support test planning, execution, and user acceptance testing (UAT) .

Perform functional validation of integrations, execute basic tests, and identify and report defects.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback and test outcomes.

Support project planning activities including estimates, schedules, and documentation in partnership with IT and project managers.

Business Process Expertise (Critical):

Deep understanding of how Workday Business Processes operate end-to-end.

Strong awareness that integration logic is driven by BP design .

Priority Business Processes include:

o Hire

o Termination

o Job Change

o Benefits & Life Events

Full mastery of all Workday BPs is not required — strong knowledge of approximately 25–50 core BPs is sufficient.

Ability to apply BP frameworks consistently across different functional areas.

Integrations (Functional Level):

Understand Workday’s integration framework and architecture .

Ability to open, review, and validate integrations against business requirements.

Execute basic functional integration testing.

Identify simple errors and communicate issues effectively to technical teams.

Write Business Requirements for new integrations .

No development or coding of integrations is expected.

Testing & Quality Assurance:

Partner closely with SDM and QA teams.

Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and test scripts .

Coordinate test cycles and track results through resolution.

Adjust requirements based on validation outcomes.

Support production deployment and post-go-live stabilization.

Stakeholder Interaction:

80% interaction with Senior HR Managers across functional workstreams (Benefits, HR Operations, etc.).

20% interaction with VP-level stakeholders on escalations and high-visibility initiatives.

This role is not heavily political; strong process mastery enables confident stakeholder engagement.

Direct leadership support is available for executive-level presentations when needed.

Immediate Focus (First Months):

Produce Business Requirements for new integrations.

Act as the central connector between business users, developers, and QA.

Refine requirements based on technical feedback.

Coordinate and oversee testing cycles.

Tools & Technical Environment:

Workday (required)

Flexibility to learn additional tools on the job.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Strong experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process documentation .

Solid understanding of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interpret data, identify issues, and recommend solutions.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

Ability to act as a key liaison between business operations and IT teams.

Experience working with senior-level business and technology stakeholders.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or related field — or equivalent experience.

5+ years of Workday HCM experience , preferably across Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, or Talent modules.

Global Workday implementation experience preferred.

Experience in enterprise-scale or financial services environments is a plus.

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.

You Are

An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.

Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.

Responsibilities
  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction
Qualifications
  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Senior Professional Services Engineer
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

This role focuses on post-sales deployment and optimization of Gigamon’s network visibility solutions, ensuring positive business outcomes for customers. The Professional Services Engineer will join a collaborative, innovative team with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, system optimization, and quality delivery. This is an individual contributor role that works closely with cross-functional teams, system architects, and end-user technical teams. The environment values technical expertise, problem-solving, and security-driven thinking. This is a hybrid role based in São Paulo (extended area), Brazil, and will occasionally require on-site support at customer locations.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead solution design, deployment, and optimization efforts for Gigamon’s network visibility and security products.
  • Work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo, Brazil, providing occasional on-site deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization support at customer locations as needed.
  • Identify deployment alternatives and propose optimized solutions for customers across various industries, including mobile networks, service providers, and enterprises.
  • Conduct testing, documentation, and pilot deliveries to ensure high-quality deployment results.
  • Work with Gigamon and customer network visibility and security teams on policy compliance efforts in line with Gigamon standards, industry privacy and security regulations, and guidelines set forth by applicable country, federal, and local laws.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing and prospective network visibility solutions, reviewing relevant use cases, security policies, and procedures with business stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with system architects to ensure business systems and applications meet security requirements in preparation for end‑user review, actively participating and contributing to internal Gigamon reviews.
  • Collaborate with Gigamon and end‑user technical teams to ensure developed tools, systems, and applications meet appropriate security standards, policies, and procedures.

What you’ve done:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in the operational design and deployment of network management tools and applications in large-scale and/or virtualized networks, supporting mobile networks, service provider, enterprise, or government use cases.
  • Strong technical expertise in network protocols (TCP/IP, L2/L3, IPv4, IPv6), virtualization (VMware, Hyper‑V), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OpenStack).
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) are highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, C) and working with APIs is a plus.
  • Proven experience leading technical initiatives without formal authority and collaborating with virtual teams across different geographies.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and cybersecurity standards (ISO 27001/27002, CIS, NIST) is highly desirable.

Who you are:

  • Fully bilingual professional (English and Portuguese) able to hold professional conversations smoothly
  • A proactive problem-solver who thrives under pressure and can effectively communicate complex technical concepts.
  • A team player with excellent interpersonal skills who can work cross-functionally and lead without formal authority.
  • Highly analytical with a deep understanding of network security principles and compliance standards.
  • Detail-oriented, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on emerging technologies.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
1. Budgeting & Forecasting:

Develop annual budgets and rolling forecasts, monitor variances, and recommend adjustments to align financial goals with business strategies. Optimize resource allocation and decompose targets to support performance achievement.

2. Business Analysis & Reporting:

Establish a business KPI framework, generate regular analytical reports, identify anomalies, and conduct root cause analysis. Propose actionable strategies to drive operational improvements and cost-efficiency.

3. Decision Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Engage with frontline operations to assess projects and design solutions. Provide financial insights for decision-making, resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, and ensure strategic execution.

4. Risk Management & Compliance:

Identify risks (e.g., revenue inflation, delivery fraud) and implement preventive controls. Monitor cash flow, receivables, and payables to mitigate bad debt and liquidity risks.

5. Data Systems & Tool Development:

Design data models and automation tools (e.g., BI dashboards) to streamline financial processes. Enhance data accuracy and analytical efficiency for precision in business operations.

6. Special Projects & Capability Building:

Lead initiatives like industry research and competitor analysis, standardizing methodologies. Conduct financial training to elevate team expertise and foster sustained business-finance integration.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior
description:
A Brunel está em busca de uma Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior (com foco em benefícios) para atuar em um contrato indeterminado junto a um de nossos clientes no setor de petróleo e gás! O regime de trabalho será de 40 horas semanais, em regime presencial, alocado no escritório do Rio de Janeiro (RJ).

Atividades:

  • Gestão operacional e transacional de benefícios , incluindo assistência médica e odontológica, vale-refeição, vale-alimentação, vale-transporte, cartão mobilidade, cartão de natal, estacionamento, previdência privada, seguro de vida, auxílio creche/babá, wellhub, PAE, auxílio farmácia, loyalty awards, check-up executivo e programas financeiros.
  • Administração de cadastros e movimentações (admissões, desligamentos, promoções, transferências, dependentes e adesões) nos sistemas de folha de pagamento (ADP) e plataformas dos fornecedores, garantindo consistência e conformidade dos dados.
  • Gestão financeira dos benefícios , incluindo solicitação, controle e baixa de bolsas de crédito, lançamentos e descontos em folha, cálculos proporcionais, ajustes conforme ACT, pagamentos retroativos e envio de relatórios contábeis de custos à área financeira.
  • Interface com fornecedores, financeiro, HRBPs e stakeholders , assegurando alinhamento de informações, cumprimento de prazos, comunicação de processos e resolução de inconsistências operacionais.
  • Análise, controle e acompanhamento de indicadores operacionais , garantindo qualidade, rastreabilidade, compliance e melhoria contínua dos processos de benefícios.
  • Suporte consultivo ao time de RH e colaboradores , atuando na solução de dúvidas, exceções e demandas específicas relacionadas aos benefícios.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior completa em Recursos Humanos, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida (nível sênior) em administração de benefícios.
  • Vivência comprovada com folha de pagamento ADP.
  • Experiência com processos transacionais de RH em grande volume.
  • Conhecimento de interface com fornecedores de benefícios.
  • Forte domínio de controles operacionais, relatórios e indicadores.
  • Conhecimento de ACT e impactos em benefícios.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado (planilhas de controle, consolidações e relatórios).
  • Perfil organizado, analítico, com atenção a detalhes e foco em prazos.
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos benefícios simultaneamente.

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.

Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional especializado(a) em automação inteligente com Inteligência Artificial, com atuação de ponta a ponta, da arquitetura à implementação em produção. Esse papel é estratégico na criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e inovadoras, conectando engenharia de software, IA aplicada a processos de negócio, automação de fluxos e cloud computing.

O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de agentes autônomos inteligentes, integrações complexas entre sistemas e orquestração de automações em ambientes multi-cloud, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares.

O modelo de contrato para esta oportunidade é CLT.

Somos inquietos, somos desbravadores e estamos em constante transformação.

Por isso, estamos na busca constante de crescimento do nosso time com profissionais inovadores, que desafiam os limites e estejam preparados para embarcar nessa cultura.

Seja qual for o seu gênero, orientação sexual, idade, raça, etnia, crença ou deficiência, todos são bem-vindos no nosso time.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de automação com IA, integradas a ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Desenvolver, treinar e evoluir agentes autônomos e assistentes virtuais utilizando LLMs, LangChain, RAG, MCP Server e Google Agentspace.

Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados para alimentar modelos de IA e fluxos automatizados.

Integrar bancos de dados relacionais, NoSQL e vetoriais.

Desenvolver APIs e microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Python e PHP.

Aplicar engenharia de prompt e arquiteturas multi-agentes em ambientes produtivos.

Desenvolver interfaces front-end leves para monitoramento e controle das automações.

Orquestrar ambientes de Cloud e DevOps com Docker, Git e pipelines CI/CD.

Garantir governança, compliance e rastreabilidade no uso de IA (versionamento de prompts, documentação e observabilidade).

Atuar em squads multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de negócio, design e tecnologia.

Desenvolvimento back-end com Node.js e/ou Python

Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços e integração de sistemas

Experiência com Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP)

Terraform (diferencial)

Diferenciais

Integrações com CRM, ERP e Martech (Salesforce, SAP BTP, RD Station, HubSpot).

Certificações em Cloud ou IA (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em fluxos automatizados mensuráveis.

Modelo de Trabalho

Perfil Comportamental

Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural.

Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.

Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade.

title: BackOffice Intern
description:

title: Solution Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

Solution Architect

At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.

What you’ll do for us

  • Participate in process and business requirements sessions and document to-be business processes leveraging industry best practices.
  • Identify and collect data, such as historical sales, shipment, inventory, logistics, and other operations / supply chain data from sources like databases, excel sheets, emails and others.
  • Ability to convert business logic to technical platform design, including knowledge of platform infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Architects and Directors to develop clear functional and technical design and document data requirements and build complex datasets.
  • Configure a technical specification document and tool configuration in the o9 platform as per the design to solve deep operations / supply chain problems and institute rigorous performance monitoring systems.
  • Use mathematical models, predictive methods, statistical techniques, optimization algorithms and simulations to analyze, manipulate and interpret large enterprise data and provide business insights and data visualization to the client management.
  • Be proficient in statistical and optimization tools and programming languages to conduct data integration through extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) and create models to generate time series forecasts and operational plans
  • Work with Internal Research and Development Teams to resolve solution gaps and deploy fixes in the customer environment
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test-cases and document issues and track progress at resolving issues.
  • Ability to design a testing protocol and implement with support from Junior Analysts, with the end goal of automating testing.
  • Work with Cross-Functional Teams, and IT and business stakeholders, to ensure successful planning and execution of projects.
  • Plan, develop and deliver Super User and End User training, for a global user base.
  • Mentor Junior Analysts to familiarize them with technical and business aspects of a project.

What you’ll have

  • Experience: Implementing supply chain planning solutions or working in the supply chain/ logistics organization.
  • Experience presenting on complex topics in a clear, concise, and easily understood manner
  • Prior experience in planning systems, and exposure to ERP tools
  • Firsthand experience leading a team through the full lifecycle of a supply chain planning solution implementation including business requirement gathering, solution design & development, UAT/SIT, go-live/cutover, and value realization
  • Experience using agile methodology to deliver large scale enterprise implementations
  • Education: Master’s Degree +4 or Bachelor Degree with 6 year experience required. Degrees in the following fields: in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields (including Supply Chain Engineering) with a concentration in operations or analytics.

Skills:

  • Supply planning experience and have worked or implemented one or multiple supply planning products is required
  • Knowledge of spreadsheets and software (Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets), document processing (Microsoft Word, Google Docs), presentation (Microsoft PowerPoint) is required
  • Knowledge and training in databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and skills one or more languages like SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar is required
  • Strong analytical techniques, data mining knowledge and proficiency in handling and processing large amounts of data is preferred
  • Ability to identify key insights and critical thinking to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is preferred Coursework and strong background in mathematics and statistics is required
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation and demonstration / training skills are required
  • Ability to communicate mathematical, technical or software usage concepts to audiences with limited prior mathematics, technical or software background is preferred
  • Ability to work in teams, distributed across locations and time zones and at executive and junior levels in a corporate hierarchy is required

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.

How the process works

  1. Apply – Submit your application by clicking the below.
  2. Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  3. Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  4. Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  5. Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  6. Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  7. HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.

More About Us

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.
